title: AIADMK submits clarification to Speaker on anti-defection petition
description: Earlier, the Speaker had sought certain clarifications from Edappadi Palaniswami after receiving written explanations from former MLAs Maragatham Kumaravel, S. Jayakumar, P. Sathyabama, and Esaki Subaya in response to notices issued to them under the anti-defection law
